note: SNG-342. Aevi: 'today reference doc and forgotten wiring are indistinguishable from outside.' Every rules file registered in the manifest that no loader fetches is listed HERE with a reason, or the build fails. This file is deliberately NOT registered in provides.rules — it is a statement about content, not content. Sits beside rules/ rather than inside it so directory sweeps of the rules corpus do not treat it as a rule.

runtime_unwired._note: Operational content with no consumer. These are REAL GAPS, not decisions. Listed so they are visible rather than silent; each needs a consumer that WANTS it (Aevi: 'a file wired without a consumer is the same failure with more steps'), so none is wired here.
runtime_unwired.martial_paths: SNG-342/CCode: baselineDefense says every character can defend itself with no build investment — that is a MECHANIC, not guidance, and no code honours it. formKits and martialBackgrounds are equipment/skill tables of the kind SNG-339 consumes. Needs a consumer in resolve.js or inventory.js; flagged for Aevi rather than wired blind.
runtime_unwired.combination_recipes: 56 cross-domain recipes + theTwelveBraids, kind=emergence. NOT superseded by world/braid_recipes.json — that is a separate loaded store with its own recipes. Two parallel authored sets, one live and one dark. Needs Erik/Aevi to say which is canon before either is wired; merging them is a content decision, not an engine one.

reference_pending_build._note: Design specs for work not yet built. Each carries a buildImplication section — the author's own statement that code should follow. Unloaded is CORRECT today; the debt is the unbuilt feature, not the missing wiring.
reference_pending_build.cross_axis_modifiers: Erik's 2026-07-07 correction on how the two thin Reaches (emotional_logical, falsehood_truth, demonic_angelic) modify across axes. Its buildImplication describes a modifier system that does not exist yet. Spec first, wiring after.
reference_pending_build.pole_signatures: Explicitly 'the content-and-resolution layer SNG-027 leans on but left undefined'. It is the missing half of the social contest, written down so it stops being lost. Wire it when social contest is built.

reference_permanent._note: Design canon and audits. These are for humans — Aevi authoring, Erik deciding. They will never have an engine consumer and should not be counted as debt.
reference_permanent.peoples_of_kind: SNG-089 canon: which traditions do not resonate with human civilization. Shapes what Aevi authors; the engine reads the resulting content, never this rationale.
reference_permanent.gambit_design: RECOVERED canon (2026-07-12) — the gambit definition lost when it lived only in a spec file. Its gmRules are authoring guidance for how Aevi writes gambits, not a runtime table.
reference_permanent.challenge_design: RECOVERED canon (2026-07-12) — the SNG-049 correction, principle, and modes. Guidance for authoring challenges. Deliberately kept as content so it cannot be lost again the way the original spec was.
reference_permanent.skill_utility_audit: Erik's meta-critique: in D&D a spell's use is obvious, many of ours are not. An AUDIT — coverageFindings and novelUses are findings about the corpus, not data the engine reads.

wired_elsewhere._note: Registered, not fetched by the loader, but genuinely consumed — the consumer is a CI check rather than engine code. Not orphans.
wired_elsewhere.power_sources: Read by tests/content_ci.mjs (3c-vii), which cross-checks power classification against substrate band centres. The audit IS its consumer.
wired_elsewhere.resolution: Fetched via rulePath("resolution") + fetchJSON rather than loadRule — a real load through a different door.
wired_elsewhere.emergence_recipes: Fetched as loadRule("emergence") — the file name and the rule name differ, which is exactly how the SNG-331 resolver regression hid.
